evidence: DEFINING BEHAVIOUR IS GRADED. The product is a custom editor whose source is run beside it and saved with history (instruction.md: 'edit code, run it and inspect the result'). tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:213 cw_basic_run_output types a program through the editor with real keys, presses Run and requires 'the preview must show the correct sum and the app console must contain it', then edits and reruns for a new sum, so a dead Run or a static preview fails. cw_custom_typing_and_line_join (line 24) and the constraints gate cw_custom_document_surface prove the own-surface editor; cw_html_preview (line 222) proves the .html mode. STATE DURABILITY IS GRADED. (a) Reload plus server-backed: constraints gate cw_shared_saved_record (tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:27-33) saves through the UI, then 'clear this origin's browser storage as described in the application notes and reload the page, so nothing held only in the browser survives', re-opens the record and checks exact title, filename and source, and reloads again. app_context.md:26 defines the clearing as localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, Cache Storage, origin private file system, service worker registrations and cookies. This is the right answer to the row's note that server-backed is not same-origin: a same-origin browser-only store is wiped before the readback, and the gate makes a localStorage/IndexedDB-only app score zero. (b) Process restart: cw_save_reload_restart (functional judge.toml:339-345) repeats the storage clear, then 'call the verifier-provided restart_app tool once. After it reports a completed restart, a fresh page must show the same single record with the same revision, title, filename, source and history. Do not infer a restart from a reload or a health response', and fails if the tool errors. The verifier MCP server is wired at judge.toml:14-18 and tests/test.sh:127-193 builds a helper that restarts node on the same DB_PATH, so an in-memory server store fails. (c) Multi-context server truth: cw_stale_save_refused, cw_live_library_update and cw_history_restore_retry read back in a third page or freshly loaded page. No re-authentication applies: the brief and app_context.md:10 state there are no accounts. PUBLIC BASIS exists for every graded demand: behaviour.md:9 'A fresh page must read the saved record from the running app, and saved work and history must survive a complete server restart'; integration.md:7 and :9. WEAK APPS TRIED: browser-storage-only library fails the gate after the clear; server Map with no database passes the gate but fails cw_save_reload_restart; an app whose Run is dead fails cw_basic_run_output and every Run-dependent row; a static shell fails the render gate. CONFORMING ALTERNATIVE TRIED: an app with different routes, schema, labels and no client cache passes, since the criteria name no route, selector or storage API and the response 'need not echo the saved fields'. RUN EVIDENCE: scripted golden on the previous commit's bytes (only judge prompt paragraphs differ) reports cw_shared_saved_record true, cw_save_reload_restart(before) true, and after a real process replacement (restart.log pid 37 -> 67) persist-after.json cw_save_reload_restart true with restart.json showing revision 2 and history [2,1]; runtime.json cw_basic_run_output true. Hashes of the six artifacts I read match raw-evidence-index.json (a94328b9..., 58a3e785..., 1a42ff68..., 722f7eca..., 56b98b0a..., e47b63b0...). No configured judge run exists for these bytes; the hosted run on an earlier candidate predates cw_basic_run_output and is not a measurement of them. NOTES (not defects). N1 (P3): cw_save_reload_restart says 'Save once', so the record carried across the restart has a one-entry history; the public promise that 'history must survive a complete server restart' is therefore only proven for a single revision by the judge, although the golden script exercises two. An app that keeps current records in SQLite but older snapshots in memory would still pass this criterion. Multi-revision history is checked only within one process lifetime (cw_history_restore_retry). Saving twice before the restart would close it at no extra tool cost. N2 (P3): server-backing is shown by clearing storage inside the single Playwright context (--isolated gives one context; app_context.md:26 'Tabs share browser storage'), not by a truly independent browser context as integration.md:7 words it. The clear list is thorough and I found no realistic browser-only store that survives it (window.name or a live peer tab re-broadcasting state are contrived), so I do not treat it as a defect. N3 (operational): the working tree is currently checked out on task/hireops-live-desk, so the artifact paths in raw-evidence-index.json do not exist on disk (only build.log and restart.log remain as ignored files); I verified the six hashes from git objects on task/colderwater-editor-strict. I did not verify the other ten indexed artifacts or the run-outputs files.
suggested_fix: Optional for N1: in cw_save_reload_restart, save a second revision with a different source before the restart and require both revisions, each with its own source, in the history afterwards.
